1.1.1: image missing alt text, empty or meaningless alt attribute, image button or image map area without alternative text, icon-only control with no text alternative, decorative image not hidden from screen readers, canvas, svg or object with no text equivalent
1.2.1: audio-only recording or silent video-only clip has no transcript or audio description alternative
1.2.2: pre-recorded video with audio has no captions or subtitles
1.2.3: pre-recorded video has no audio description or full text alternative for visual content
1.2.4: live video with audio has no real-time captions
1.2.5: pre-recorded video has no synchronized audio description track
1.3.1: headings, lists, tables or form groups not marked up semantically, fake headings made with bold text, data table cells without header associations, list items outside a list, definition list structure broken, required child or parent ARIA roles missing, landmarks and regions missing, visual structure not conveyed in the markup
1.3.2: reading order in the source differs from the visual order, CSS positioning makes content order meaningless, tabindex or layout changes the sequence
1.3.3: instructions rely only on shape, size, color, position or sound such as 'click the round button' or 'the item on the right'
1.3.4: content locked to portrait or landscape orientation, page restricts display orientation
1.3.5: form field collecting personal data lacks a valid autocomplete attribute, invalid autocomplete token on name, email, address or phone input
1.4.1: color is the only way to convey information, links distinguished from surrounding text only by color, required fields or errors indicated only by color
1.4.2: audio plays automatically for more than three seconds with no way to pause, stop or control volume
1.4.3: text has insufficient color contrast against its background, low contrast ratio below 4.5:1 or 3:1 for large text, light gray text, placeholder or button text hard to read
1.4.4: text cannot be resized to 200 percent, zoom disabled by viewport meta with user-scalable=no or maximum-scale, content lost or clipped when text is enlarged
1.4.5: text embedded in an image instead of real text, images of text used for headings or buttons
1.4.10: page requires horizontal scrolling or two-dimensional scrolling at 320 CSS pixels width, content not responsive when zoomed to 400 percent
1.4.11: UI component border, icon, focus indicator or graphic has insufficient contrast, low contrast against adjacent colors below 3:1
1.4.12: text spacing overrides of line height, letter spacing, word spacing or paragraph spacing cause clipped or overlapping text, fixed height containers cut off text
1.4.13: tooltip or hover or focus popup content disappears when the pointer moves onto it, cannot be dismissed with Escape, does not stay visible
2.1.1: functionality not operable with the keyboard alone, click handlers on non-interactive elements, scrollable region or frame not keyboard focusable, image map server-side click coordinates, mouse-only controls
2.1.2: keyboard focus gets trapped in a component such as a modal or widget and cannot leave using the keyboard
2.1.4: single-character keyboard shortcut cannot be turned off, remapped or limited to focus
2.2.1: session or form times out without warning or option to extend, time limit cannot be turned off or adjusted, meta refresh redirects after a delay
2.2.2: moving, blinking, scrolling or auto-updating content such as a marquee, carousel or animation cannot be paused, stopped or hidden
2.3.1: content flashes more than three times per second, flashing or strobing animation
2.4.1: no skip link or bypass mechanism to jump past repeated navigation, no main landmark or landmark regions, content not contained in landmarks, repeated blocks cannot be skipped
2.4.2: page has no title, empty title element, same or non-descriptive page title on every page
2.4.3: tab order is illogical, positive tabindex values scramble focus order, focus moves unexpectedly, focus not moved into a dialog
2.4.4: link has no discernible text, empty link, vague link text such as click here or read more, link purpose unclear from its text, image link without alt text
2.4.5: no way to find pages other than navigation, no site search, sitemap or consistent navigation set
2.4.6: heading or label is empty, not descriptive, headings skip levels or do not describe the section, heading hierarchy out of order, labels do not describe purpose
2.4.7: keyboard focus indicator is invisible, outline removed with outline:none, no visible focus style on links or buttons
2.5.1: multi-touch or path-based gesture such as swipe or pinch is the only way to operate a function
2.5.2: action triggers on pointer down event, cannot be cancelled or undone by moving away before release
2.5.3: accessible name of a control does not contain its visible label text, aria-label differs from visible text so voice control users cannot activate it
2.5.4: function only works by shaking, tilting or moving the device, no UI alternative to motion actuation
3.1.1: html element has no lang attribute, missing or invalid language of the page, wrong page language code
3.1.2: passage in another language is not marked with a lang attribute, foreign language phrase not identified
3.2.1: receiving focus on a field automatically triggers a change of context such as opening a window or submitting a form
3.2.2: changing a form control value such as a select or checkbox automatically submits the form or navigates, change of context on input without warning
3.2.3: navigation menus or repeated components appear in a different order or position on different pages, inconsistent navigation
3.2.4: components with the same function are labeled or named inconsistently across pages
3.3.1: form errors not identified or described in text, error indicated only visually, invalid input gives no error message, error message not associated with the field
3.3.2: form input has no label or instructions, missing label element, placeholder used instead of a label, unlabeled text field, select or checkbox, required field not indicated
3.3.3: error message gives no suggestion for how to correct the input, no guidance on fixing the mistake
3.3.4: legal, financial or data submission cannot be reversed, checked or confirmed before final submit
4.1.1: invalid HTML markup, duplicate id attributes, elements not properly nested or closed, parsing errors
4.1.2: button, link or form control has no accessible name, input without label or aria-label, iframe or frame without title, custom widget missing role or state, invalid ARIA role, attribute or attribute value, required ARIA attributes missing, aria-hidden on a focusable element, select or button with no discernible text, ARIA misuse, name role and value not exposed to assistive technology
4.1.3: status message such as a success notice, error summary, search result count or loading update not announced by screen readers, missing aria-live or role=status alert
